description:
"End every single sentence with 'Sir, yes, sir' or 'Sir, no, sir.' Understood?"

"Understood, sir!"

"Wait, didn't I just say I understood, sir?"

Before she could be sold off to the Emperor, Henrietta beat up her own husband with her bare hands and got a divorce.
To reclaim her family's fortune abandoned deep within the Monster Forest, she enlists in the military—and begins wreaking havoc for the very first time in the life of a Duke who was practically dying of boredom.
